# discord_voice_channel (Resource)

Manages a Discord voice channel.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the voice channel (1-100 characters).
- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID where the channel will be created.

### Optional

- `bitrate` (Number) The bitrate of the voice channel (8000-96000 for normal, up to 384000 for boosted servers).
- `category` (String) The ID of the parent category channel.
- `position` (Number) The position of the channel in the channel list.
- `sync_perms_with_category` (Boolean) Whether to sync permissions with the parent category.
- `user_limit` (Number) The user limit of the voice channel (0-99). 0 means unlimited.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the channel.
